source_evidence: This feature may only be available in certain years, or if a certain level of premiums are paid. When elected, a no-lapse feature may significantly reduce your death benefit.
question: Misconception: A no-lapse feature guarantees that a variable life policy will stay in force regardless of the policy’s terms or premiums. What is the correction?
answer: A no-lapse feature can keep a policy in effect even when account value is insufficient to pay fees and expenses, but its protection may depend on the years it is available or on paying a required level of premiums. It may also significantly reduce the death benefit.
